dz: 君士坦丁二世,君士坦丁斯二世和康斯坦斯都继承了他们的父亲君士坦丁一世为同监. 罗马帝国由奥古斯都三所分出.
de: Constantine II, Constantius II, and Constans succeed their father Constantine I as co-emperors. The Roman Empire is divided between the three Augusti.
